name: ZeroClaw
description: ZeroClaw is a personal AI agent runtime written in Rust. A single binary connects to 80+ LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and others), routes messages from 40+ channels (Discord, Telegram, Matrix, webhooks), and executes tools such as shell commands, web browsing, and HTTP requests. You own the agent, the data, and the machine it runs on.

notes.text: Open http://<IP>:42617 in a browser and run the quickstart wizard. You must configure at least one LLM provider (API key for Anthropic, OpenAI, or a local Ollama address) and create an agent before ZeroClaw is functional.

The gateway binds to 0.0.0.0:42617 with no authentication by default. Restrict access to a trusted network or add a reverse proxy with auth before exposing it publicly. A session token can be configured in /opt/zeroclaw_data/zeroclaw/config.toml under [gateway].
ZeroClaw does not run models locally — it proxies requests to external providers. Point it at an existing Ollama container or a hosted API such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
All persistent data lives in /opt/zeroclaw_data (outside the app directory), so it survives updates. Include /opt/zeroclaw_data in regular backups.
